integrity: The result is proved from the centered-overlap representation, a Brunn–Minkowski concavity argument that optimizes over all centers, the rotational symmetry of a regular polygon, and an exact half-plane computation of the centered overlap.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for regular Euclidean polygons. No stability under perturbation and no formula for arbitrary cyclic or equiangular polygons is claimed. The historical originality check carries residual risk because the central-kernel literature begins in 1950.
title: Exact Kovner–Besicovitch measure of every regular polygon
